identificationModule.briefTitle: Single vs Double Umbilical Cord Blood Transplants in Children With High Risk Leukemia and Myelodysplasia (BMT CTN 0501)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Multi-center, Open Label, Randomized Trial Comparing Single Versus Double Umbilical Cord Blood (UCB) Transplantation in Pediatric Patients With High Risk Leukemia and Myelodysplasia (BMT CTN #0501)

armGroups.label: Single Cord Blood Transplant
armGroups.description: Unrelated donor, single umbilical cord blood unit transplant; conditioning regimen: Total Body Irradiation/cyclophosphamide/fludarabine; GVHD prophylaxis: Cyclosporine A/Mycophenolate Mofetil
interventionNames: Biological: Single Umbilical Cord Blood Unit Transplant

armGroups.label: Double Cord Blood Transplant
armGroups.description: Unrelated donor, double umbilical cord blood unit transplant; Conditioning regimen: Total Body Irradiation/cyclophosphamide/fludarabine; GVHD prophylaxis: Cyclosporine A/Mycophenolate Mofetil
interventionNames: Biological: Double Umbilical Cord Blood Unit Transplant

interventions.name: Single Umbilical Cord Blood Unit Transplant
interventions.description: Unrelated donor, single umbilical cord blood unit; conditioning regimen: TBI/cyclophosphamide/fludarabine; GVHD prophylaxis: cyclosporine/MMF

interventions.name: Double Umbilical Cord Blood Unit Transplant
interventions.description: Unrelated donor, double umbilical cord blood unit; Conditioning regimen: TBI/cyclophosphamide/fludarabine; GVHD prophylaxis: cyclosporine/MMF

interventions.name: Total Body Irradiation
interventions.description: The TBI will be delivered from either a linear accelerator or cobalt source at a dose rate of between 4 and 26 cGy/minute using energies of between 1 and 25 MV.

interventions.name: Cyclophosphamide
interventions.description: Cyclophosphamide 60 mg/kg/day will be administered as a 2 hour intravenous infusion with a high volume fluid flush on Days -3 and -2.

interventions.name: Fludarabine
interventions.description: Fludarabine 25 mg/m2/day will be administered over 30-60 minutes intravenous infusion on Days -10 through -8. Fludarabine will not be dose adjusted for body weight.

interventions.name: Cyclosporine A
interventions.description: CSA will be administered beginning on Day -3 and doses will be adjusted to maintain a level of 200-400 ng/mL by TDX method (or 100-250 ng/mL by Tandem MS or equivalent level for other CSA testing methods). CSA can be administered per institutional practice.

interventions.name: Mycophenolate Mofetil
interventions.description: MMF will be given at a dose of 1 gram IV q 8 hours if \> 50 kg or 15 mg/kg IV q 8 hours if \< 50 kg beginning the morning of Day -3.
